pdp.page_title: Super C Smart Nutrient Beauty Capsules — Liva Skincare
pdp.meta_desc: Super C Smart Nutrient Beauty Capsules and botanical set — reduces uneven pigmentation, brightens skin tone, and restores natural radiant glow.
pdp.title: Super C Smart Nutrient Beauty Capsules
pdp.bullet1: Reduces Uneven Pigmentation And Evens Out Skin Tone.
pdp.bullet2: It Brightens Your Skin Tone And Adds A Natural Glow To It.
pdp.bullet3: Reduces Dark Spots To Reveal Visibly Fairer Skin.
pdp.item3: Mz Skin Reviving Antioxidant Glow Oil
pdp.desc_p1: The Super C Smart Nutrient Beauty Capsules delivers concentrated botanical nutrition to revitalize dull, fatigued skin. Formulated with stable Vitamin C esters, organic plant sterols, and bio-compatible lipids, each single-dose capsule preserves maximum antioxidant potency until the exact moment of application.
pdp.desc_p2: Clinically tested to boost natural skin radiance and support cellular collagen synthesis, this restorative set pairs seamlessly with our deep hydrating botanical serums for a luminous, firm, and thoroughly replenished complexion.
pdp.in_set_1: Super C Smart Nutrient Beauty Capsules (60 biodegradable capsules)
pdp.in_set_2: Charlotte Tilbury Magic Skin Duo primer & glow elixir
pdp.in_set_3: Ren Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 (30ml) deep moisture serum
pdp.in_set_4: Mz Skin Reviving Antioxidant Glow Oil (treatment dropper bottle)
pdp.spec_v1: Stable Vitamin C (Tetrahexyldecyl Ascorbate), Hyaluronic Acid, Vitamin E & F, Botanical Seed Oils
pdp.spec_v2: Suitable for all skin types, including sensitive and mature skin
pdp.spec_v4: Silky, rapidly absorbed dry oil and nutrient gel
pdp.spec_v5: Formulated in London & sustainably crafted with organic botanical extracts
pdp.spec_v6: Leaping Bunny certified, never tested on animals
pdp.spec_v7: 18 months (sealed capsules maintain 100% active vitamin potency)
pdp.rev_body: This set transformed my skincare routine completely. After two weeks of using the Super C capsules and serum, my sun spots have faded noticeably and my skin has a healthy dewy glow without feeling greasy at all.
pdp.step1_body: Start with freshly cleansed, slightly damp skin using lukewarm water to prepare your pores for active vitamin absorption.
pdp.step2_body: Twist off the tip of one Super C Smart Nutrient Capsule. Squeeze the silky serum into the palm of your hand.
pdp.step3_body: Press serum gently into face, neck, and decollete in upward circular motions. Allow 60 seconds for full absorption.
pdp.step4_title: Step 4: Layer with Duo & Glow Oil
pdp.step4_body: Follow with your Magic Skin Duo hydration and seal in maximum nourishment with 2–3 drops of the Reviving Glow Oil.
pdp.pro_tip_body: For optimal skin brightness and antioxidant protection, apply one capsule every morning followed by your preferred SPF.
about.meta_desc: Discover the Liva Skincare story — pure botanical formulas, certified organic seed extracts, and mindful daily rituals.
about.title: Pure Botanical Science for Mindful Daily Rituals
about.lead: At Liva, we formulate clean, restorative skincare centered around nutrient-dense botanical extracts, cold-pressed seed oils, and proven active vitamins. We believe daily self-care should be nourishing, uncomplicated, and deeply restorative.
about.story_h2: Crafted to Nourish Your Skin Barrier
about.story_p1: Liva began with a singular conviction: modern skincare should work in harmony with your skin's natural biology rather than overwhelming it with harsh synthetic fillers and aggressive chemical agents.
about.story_p2: Each formulation is meticulously blended in our laboratory using sustainably harvested seed extracts, stabilized antioxidants, and deeply hydrating lipid complexes. From our signature beauty capsules to gentle purifying washes, we ensure every drop delivers maximum cellular vitality.
about.check2: Free from parabens, sulfates, and synthetic dyes
about.check3: Sustainably packaged in recyclable amber glass & refillable pouches
about.cta_p: Elevate your morning and evening ritual with our Super C capsules and revitalizing nutrient oils.
